blocks.html: The minimum openable area to the outdoors shall be 5 percent of the floor area of the space being ventilated. Every window or skylight providing required natural ventilation shall be at least 3 square feet (0.28 m 2 ) providing a minimum of 1 1/2 square feet (0.14 m 2 ) of openable area.
